name: Tom Simmons Custom Woodworking
old_description: I specialize in custom cabinetry, including kitchen cabinets, vanities, and built-ins, in the greater Des Moines area. I pride myself on my reputation for quality craftsmanship and attention to detail.
about:
Tom Simmons Custom Woodworking operates as a sole proprietorship in Des Moines, Iowa, serving homeowners throughout the greater Des Moines metropolitan area. The business is owned and run by Tom Simmons, who works directly with clients on custom cabinetry projects.

The shop fabricates custom kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, and built-in furniture pieces. Each project is tailored to the client's specifications, with an emphasis on fit, finish, and integration into existing home architecture. Work is performed in Simmons' workshop using woodworking methods suited to custom one-off production.

Customers are primarily residential homeowners undertaking kitchen and bathroom remodels or new construction, along with occasional contractors seeking custom millwork. The company does not maintain a retail showroom; instead, Simmons shares a portfolio of completed projects on his website and points prospective clients to Google reviews for reference.

Simmons cites quality craftsmanship and attention to detail as the foundation of his reputation, and he aims to deliver cost-effective solutions that enhance the beauty, enjoyment, and long-term value of clients' homes.
